exposure: Variations in the CD81 large extracellular loop (LEL) gene sequence
HCV RNA negative patients with spontaneous viral clearance
patients at high risk of HCV infection (exposed but uninfected)
outcome: Susceptibility to HCV infection and outcome of HCV infection
cohort: Patients with and without HCV infection (n=62)
finding: No sequence variations were found in the CD81 LEL gene region important for HCV binding in any of the patient groups, suggesting that variations in this region do not influence susceptibility to or outcome of HCV infection.
